version: 1
id: voice-compose-test
label: Composed Tone
purpose: Test voice for compose fixtures
narrator_distance: third-person singular observer
evidence_posture: empirical and measured
sentence_movement: straightforward and declarative
paragraph_movement: linear and methodical
transitions: minimal connective tissue; facts speak for themselves
emotional_temperature: neutral scientific
quote_handling: exact block with ellipsis for brevity
avoid:
  - speculation without grounding
  - promotional framing
